# #22 — feat: search should boost hot tier entries over cold in ranking

## Problem
When searching for 'armnet pro', OB returns 10 cold entries and 0 hot entries in the top 10 -- even though a hot consolidated entry exists with that exact content. The hot entry only surfaces with a more specific query like 'CONSOLIDATED ArmNet Pro Development Summary'.

## Expected Behavior
Hot tier entries should get a ranking boost in search results. A hot entry with relevant content should always outrank a cold entry with similar relevance.

## Current Behavior
Search ranking appears to be purely based on vector distance / FTS score, with no tier-based boost applied to the final ranking.

## Proposed Fix
Apply a multiplier to the search score based on tier:
- hot: 1.5x boost
- warm: 1.0x (no change)
- cold: 0.5x penalty

This ensures the tiering system actually affects what users see in search results, not just what's stored.

## Context
Discovered during OB dream cycle 2026-04-09. After cleaning 500+ entries into proper tiers, search quality for most queries is excellent (SOP: 10/10 hot, paperclip: 9/10 hot), but certain queries still surface cold noise over hot signal.
